dates.name: Park City Gondola Art Stroll & Dinner — Canyons Village
dates.desc: Experience six unique art installations housed in retired gondola cabins at Canyons Village. Enjoy an evening strolling through contemporary art and mountain views (last chance — this runs through April 2026!). Followed by dinner at a nearby Park City restaurant like Tupelo or Riverhorse.
dates.where: Canyons Village — 3100 W Canyons Resort Dr, Park City, UT 84098

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. San Diego FC — MLS Soccer
dates.desc: Major League Soccer matchup at America First Field under the April evening lights. Real Salt Lake takes on San Diego FC in a competitive Western Conference bout. Perfect Saturday night for outdoor soccer with ideal spring weather and full stadium energy.
dates.where: America First Field — 9220 S State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees Minor League Baseball — Sunday Afternoon Game
dates.desc: Casual, fun minor league baseball at The Ballpark at America First Square. Local talent, friendly crowd, great hot dogs and concessions. Sunday afternoon game is a perfect low-key date with plenty of banter time between innings. Bring a glove — foul balls are fair game!
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — 77 W South Temple, South Jordan, UT 84095

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. Inter Miami FC — MESSI SPECIAL EVENT
dates.desc: Historic matchup: Lionel Messi and Inter Miami FC visit America First Field. This is a can't-miss opportunity to see one of the greatest soccer players of all time in a Real Salt Lake home game. Expect a full stadium, high energy, and incredible soccer. Tickets will be premium.
dates.where: America First Field — 9220 S State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: The Phantom of the Opera — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: The revitalized production of Andrew Lloyd Webber's legendary musical. Since you loved this show before, here's another chance to experience the stunning choreography, powerful vocals, and sweeping orchestration. Evening performance on Friday for the perfect date night.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Spring Festival at Utah State Fairpark — Live Music, Food & Culture
dates.desc: Festive community celebration with live music, dancing, artisan vendors, food trucks, and family-friendly activities blending cultural traditions with modern festival vibes. Browse local goods, sample international cuisines, and enjoy live performances under the spring sky.
dates.where: Utah State Fairpark — 155 N 1000 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

dates.name: Ensign Peak — Sunset Hike with Valley Views
dates.desc: Short 1.3-mile hike with panoramic views of Salt Lake Valley, Great Salt Lake, Wasatch and Oquirrh Mountains. Time it for sunset to catch the colors reflecting off the lake. Classic local favorite with accessible trailhead and spring wildflowers in bloom.
dates.where: Ensign Peak Trailhead — 2840 E Bonneville Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Bonneville Shoreline Trail — Wildflower & Views Loop
dates.desc: 3.7-mile moderate hike with steep elevation gain showcasing spring wildflowers (April is peak bloom!), ridge-top views, and natural terrain. Less crowded than Ensign Peak with equally rewarding vistas. Great for photography and exploring beyond the typical tourist trails.
dates.where: Bonneville Shoreline Trailhead — 2660 Terrace Hills Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84109

dates.name: Lost Prospector Trail — Park City Ridge Hike
dates.desc: Park City classic accessible as an out-and-back or loop hike along the ridgeline above Historic Main Street. Spring conditions are ideal with warming temps and wildflower buds emerging. Fewer crowds than summer and stunning Wasatch views. Perfect for exploring Park City's mountain backdrop.
dates.where: Lost Prospector Trailhead — Park City, UT (access via Town Lift or ridge trails)

dates.name: Donut Falls — Easy Waterfall Hike in Alta Canyon
dates.desc: 2-mile easy hike to a quirky natural tunnel in the rocks with a small waterfall. April runoff adds to the water flow and scenery. Very beginner-friendly with fun photo ops. Great for a quick adventure before lunch or coffee.
dates.where: Donut Falls Trailhead — Little Cottonwood Canyon Rd, UT (~20 miles from SLC)

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Spring Stroll & Dining
dates.desc: Charming walkable historic district lined with galleries, boutiques, and diverse restaurants. Browse local art, grab spring coffee at a café, and choose from pizza, sushi, burgers, or upscale dining. Many venues feature patios that open in April. Weekend live music adds to the vibe.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (various restaurants/galleries)

dates.name: Scenic Drive: Snowbird/Alta Canyons & Lunch
dates.price: $30 - $80 (lunch costs vary; canyon drive is free)
dates.desc: Drive through Little Cottonwood and Snowbird Canyon with towering peaks, spring runoff waterfalls, and mountain scenery. Stop at a summit restaurant for lunch with views, or picnic at a scenic pullout. April weather is ideal — not too hot, trails are opening.
dates.where: Little Cottonwood Canyon Road — Salt Lake City to Snowbird Resort area

dates.name: Mini Golf Night — Rounds or Local Course
dates.desc: Since you enjoyed mini golf before, try a different course in the area or revisit Rounds for another round. Casual, competitive, and fun — perfect for a quick evening or afternoon date. Grab snacks or drinks alongside the game.
dates.where: Rounds or alternate mini golf venue — Salt Lake City area

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing — Red Rock Climbing Center
dates.desc: Beginner-friendly gym with hundreds of routes at all levels. No experience necessary — staff teaches everything. Active, fun, slightly competitive, and genuinely rewarding. Even easy walls feel like an accomplishment. Great date chemistry builder.
dates.where: Red Rock Climbing Center — 2074 E Fort Union Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121

dates.name: Park City Gallery Walk — Art & Local Coffee
dates.desc: Stroll through Park City's gallery scene with local artists, rotating exhibits, and creative installations. Pop into cafés like Grind or The Cabin for coffee and light bites. Many galleries are intimate and welcoming. Perfect low-key cultural afternoon.
dates.where: Park City — Various galleries and cafés on Main Street

dates.name: Utah Museum of Contemporary Art — Exhibitions & Vibes
dates.desc: Free/low-cost admission to rotating contemporary art exhibitions. Smaller than the art festival you tried before, so more curated and focused. Great for an afternoon museum hop followed by coffee or lunch in Downtown Salt Lake.
dates.where: Utah Museum of Contemporary Art — 20 S West Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Themed Cook-Off Challenge — New Cuisine
dates.desc: Pick a cuisine you haven't cooked together before — Thai, Lebanese, Japanese, Korean, Moroccan, Vietnamese. Shop together for ingredients, then challenge yourselves to make a full meal from scratch. Set timers, taste-test, laugh at attempts, and enjoy the creative result.
dates.where: Home

dates.name: Board Game Tournament — Bracket & Snacks
dates.desc: Pick 2-3 board games you've never played together. Create a tournament bracket, keep cumulative scores, and crown a champion. Grab snacks, make it fun and competitive. Surprisingly engaging and perfect for an evening in.
dates.where: Home

dates.name: Movie Night at Home — Cozy & Candlelit
dates.desc: Pick a movie, light candles, make popcorn or order takeout, and snuggle in for a cozy evening. April weather is perfect for opening windows and enjoying spring air. Zero pressure, 100% comfort.
dates.where: Home

dates.name: Escape Room — Getout Games Downtown
dates.desc: Four themed rooms: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under pressure. Book in advance for evening slots. Tests your chemistry and problem-solving as a team.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Thanksgiving Point — Museum Combo in Lehi
dates.desc: Explore multiple museums in one destination: Museum of Ancient Life (dinosaurs), Museum of Natural Curiosity (hands-on exhibits), Butterfly Biosphere, and 55-acre Ashton Gardens. Spring is perfect for the botanical gardens. Can be done selectively or as a full day.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point — 3900 N Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84043
